response_text:
Several nonprofit **donor / fundraising CRMs integrate directly with QuickBooks** so you can avoid double entry and keep accounting clean. Below are some of the more widely used options, plus how they integrate and key differentiators.

---

### 1. DonorSnap

- **QuickBooks versions:** Online **and** Desktop (PC)[1]  
- **How it syncs:**
  - You enter donations in DonorSnap and then **push transactions in batches** to QuickBooks.[1]
  - Map **DonorSnap accounting codes → GL income accounts** and **payment methods → asset accounts** in QuickBooks.[1]
  - Optionally link **individual donors to QuickBooks customers** to keep detail in both systems.[1]
- **Good fit if:**  
  - You use QuickBooks Desktop, or  
  - You want no added fee for the QuickBooks integration (included with DonorSnap)[1].

---

### 2. Donorbox

- **QuickBooks versions:** **QuickBooks Online only**[2]  
- **How it syncs:**
  - Native integration that **automatically syncs one-time & recurring donations, ticket sales, and other transactions** into QuickBooks Online.[2]
  - Posts either as **Sales Receipts** or **Invoice + Payment**.[2]
  - Real-time sync after setup; you can monitor status (synced/pending/failed) in a dedicated dashboard.[2]
- **Setup details:**
  - Connect via the “Integrations & Add-ons” area in Donorbox.[2]
  - Use a setup wizard and **map campaigns to accounts, products/services, and custom fields** in QuickBooks.[2]
  - Requires your **income accounts, items, and custom fields to already exist** in QuickBooks; integration does not create them.[2]
  - Costs **$50/month** as an add-on to Donorbox plans.[2]
- **Good fit if:**  
  - You’re donation-form–centric, mainly online giving,  
  - You want near real-time sync to QuickBooks Online and don’t mind an extra monthly fee.

---

### 3. DonorPerfect

- **QuickBooks versions:** **QuickBooks Online** (official integration; Desktop is separate/manual)[4][6]  
- **How it syncs:**
  - DonorPerfect acts as your **donor and gift “system of record”**, then you **post gifts to QuickBooks Online**.[4][6]
  - Can **post as individual, daily, or monthly summaries** (via journal entries).[4][6]
  - Map **gifts to bank accounts, income accounts, and classes** and can map donors to QuickBooks customers.[4][6]
- **Setup details:**
  - Integration is an add-on on many DonorPerfect packages; enabled through the Apps menu and “Connect to QuickBooks” flow.[6]
  - Requires admin rights in QuickBooks Online to authorize and then walk through a multi-step mapping process.[6]
- **Good fit if:**  
  - You want a full-featured donor CRM with robust reporting and  
  - Need flexible posting (summary vs detailed) into QuickBooks Online.

---

### 4. Funraise

- **QuickBooks versions:** **QuickBooks Online**[3]  
- **How it syncs:**
  - Sends **donation and donor data** to QuickBooks Online.[3]
  - Creates **Sales Receipts for donations** and **Customers for donors**.[3]
  - Lets you map **Account, Class, and Product/Service** fields and customize fee reporting.[3]
- **Good fit if:**  
  - You’re a growth-oriented nonprofit using modern online fundraising tools  
  - You want QuickBooks Online to mirror donors and donations in some detail.

---

### 5. Method:Donor (built for QuickBooks)

- **QuickBooks versions:** **All versions** of QuickBooks, with **two-way, real-time integration**.[5]  
- **How it syncs:**
  - Designed as donor management on top of Method CRM, which was built around QuickBooks.[5]
  - Donations entered in Method automatically **sync to QuickBooks**, eliminating double entry.[5]
  - Also syncs contacts, so donor details flow to QuickBooks “just the way your accountant likes it.”[5]
- **Good fit if:**  
  - QuickBooks is central to your operations, possibly including Desktop, and  
  - You want a donor system architected explicitly around QuickBooks integration.

---

### 6. OnlineGiving.org

- **QuickBooks versions:** **Online and Desktop**[7]  
- **How it syncs:**
  - Automates **financial deposit creation** from closed giving batches into QuickBooks.[7]
  - Focus is on deposits rather than full donor CRM records.
- **Good fit if:**  
  - You primarily want online giving plus automated deposits in QuickBooks, not a full donor CRM.

---

### How to choose among them

Key questions to narrow it down:

- **Which QuickBooks are you on?**
  - Need **Desktop support** → DonorSnap, Method:Donor, OnlineGiving.org.  
  - **Online only** → All listed; Donorbox, DonorPerfect, Funraise are Online-specific.

- **How automated should the sync be?**
  - **Real-time/automatic:** Donorbox[2], Method:Donor[5], Funraise[3].  
  - **Batch/manual “post to QB” step:** DonorSnap[1], DonorPerfect[4][6], OnlineGiving.org[7].

- **Level of detail in QuickBooks:**
  - Summary posting (good for a clean GL): DonorPerfect (daily/monthly summaries)[4][6].  
  - Detailed per-donation records: Donorbox[2], Funraise[3], DonorSnap (if you link customers)[1], Method:Donor[5].

- **Budget sensitivity:**
  - Donorbox’s QuickBooks connector is an **extra $50/month**.[2]  
  - DonorSnap includes integration at **no extra cost** beyond its subscription.[1]  
  - Method:Donor, Funraise, DonorPerfect will have varying package pricing.

If you share your QuickBooks version (Online vs Desktop), your donor volume, and whether you want summaries or detailed records in QuickBooks, I can narrow this down to 2–3 best-fit options with pros/cons tailored to your situation.
